analysis.summary: In the Q1 FY27 earnings call, Krishana Phoschem Limited reported revenue from operations of ₹532 crore, up 35% year-on-year, and PAT of ₹47 crore, up 54% year-on-year. Management noted that raw material supply disruptions and West Asia geopolitical tensions created a challenging operating environment during the quarter. However, a material revival in monsoon conditions during July drove a rapid recovery in Kharif sowing and fertilizer demand. The company expects to achieve a quarterly turnover exceeding ₹500 crore over the remaining quarters of FY27 as raw material supplies normalize and capacity utilization improves. In Q1 FY27, Krishana Phoschem reported a 34.58% YoY revenue increase to ₹532.3 crore and a 53.88% YoY rise in Profit After Tax to ₹47.06 crore, supported by sustained capacity utilization and efficiency across its integrated value chain.

guidance.claim: Krishana Phoschem expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: Management expressed confidence in sustaining momentum through the remainder of FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident of building on this momentum through the remainder of FY27, as we continue strengthening India's agri-future for our farmers, partners, & shareholders

guidance.claim: Management expects to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

guidance.claim: Overall revenue growth for FY27 is expected to be in the range of 35% to 40%.
guidance.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: Growth in the manufacturing segment for FY27 is projected to be in the range of 25%.
guidance.quote: And based on the capacity utilization on a reasonable level, the growth in the manufacturing will be in the range of 25%.

demand_outlook.claim: By the end of June, cumulative rainfall was nearly 40% below normal, causing national Kharif sowing to drop by 22.7% year-on-year to 182.7 lakh hectares.
demand_outlook.quote: By the end of June, cumulative rainfall was nearly 40% below normal, resulting in national Kharif sowing declining by 22.7% year-on-year to 182.7 lakh hectares, compared to 236.5 lakh hectares during the corresponding period last year.

demand_outlook.claim: Improved rainfall in early July resulted in a rapid recovery in sowing progress and accelerated fertilizer offtake across key markets.
demand_outlook.quote: However, rainfall improved materially during early July, resulting in a rapid recovery in sowing progress, improved farmer sentiment, and accelerated fertilizer offtake across several key markets for the remainder of the Kharif season.

demand_outlook.claim: During April-May 2026, industry production dropped 28% year-on-year while SSP production fell by about 7%.
demand_outlook.quote: During the April-May 2026 period, industry-wide production declined by 28% year-on-year, while SSP production dropped by around 7% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth supported by strong demand fundamentals.
demand_outlook.quote: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth, supported by strong demand fundamentals.

demand_outlook.claim: The Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry due to comfortable domestic stocks and a favorable monsoon forecast.
demand_outlook.quote: With comfortable domestic stock levels & a favourable monsoon forecast, the Kharif season demand environment appears constructive for the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter ended March 2026 witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: March saw a natural seasonal moderation in demand as key crops approached maturity consistent with typical fertilizer application cycles.
demand_outlook.quote: March saw a natural seasonal moderation in demand as key crops such as wheat and mustard approached maturity consistent with typical fertilizer application cycles.

demand_outlook.claim: A stable agricultural environment supported by a favorable monsoon outlook provides a constructive demand outlook.
demand_outlook.quote: On one hand, a stable agricultural environment supported by a favorable monsoon outlook provides a constructive demand outlook.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure even if demand softens, as imports would absorb the impact first.
demand_outlook.quote: From our perspective, domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure. Even hypothetically, if demand were to soften, it is important to note that nearly 40% of phosphatic fertilizers are imported. Therefore, any impact would first be absorbed by imports, and domestic manufacturers would remain relatively insulated.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is evaluating capacity expansion opportunities that have not yet been approved or disclosed.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities.

capex_expansion.claim: Details regarding future capex will be shared once finalized and approved by the Board.
capex_expansion.quote: Since these have not yet been approved or disclosed through the statutory channels, we are not in a position to share details at this stage.

capex_expansion.claim: Expanded capacities at Meghnagar for NPK/DAP (165,000 MTPA) and Sulphuric Acid (99,000 MTPA) are progressively contributing to performance.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: NPK/DAP capacity was enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity stands at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Backward integration was strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity expansion was funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans.
capex_expansion.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has not planned any additional capex beyond what has already been implemented.
capex_expansion.quote: No, so far, we have not planned anything. Whatever we have, it has been implemented.

margins_costs.claim: Krishana Phoschem earned EBITDA margins of approximately 7%-8% on trading and around 16% on manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company passed on approximately 25%-30% of input cost increases through higher subsidies and revised selling prices.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly EBITDA grew 36% year-on-year to ₹89 crore.
margins_costs.quote: Quarterly EBITDA stood at ₹ 89 crore, reflecting a 36% year-on-year growth, supported by disciplined cost management, despite volatility in raw material prices.

margins_costs.claim: Lower-cost inventory carried forward from the previous quarter contributed to higher EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, the inventory carried forward from the previous quarter at lower costs did contribute to the higher EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore due to improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

margins_costs.claim: From mid-February onwards, the global market witnessed firming input trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, and higher logistic and freight costs.
margins_costs.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

margins_costs.claim: Ammonia and sulphur prices moved up sequentially during the quarter, creating higher cost pressure.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, ammonia prices moved up sequentially during the quarter. Sulphur prices also firmed up towards March. This created a timing mismatch where domestic demand was slowed down in March while input costs were increasing, leading to higher cost pressure in the closing quarter.

margins_costs.claim: Profitability is expected to come down slightly during the current year FY27 due to input price increases.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, of course, we will absorb to some extent and as a result, our profitability is expected to come down slightly during the current year FY27.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration has been a key contributor, which is why EBITDA margins are higher than peers.
margins_costs.quote: Backward integration has been a key contributor, which is why our EBITDA margins are higher than peers.

orders_capacity.claim: Total fertilizer production reached 89,747 metric tonnes during the quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, showcasing our consistent operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: The NPK-DAP unit operated at 43% capacity utilization while the SSP unit operated at 121% capacity utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: The addition of 165,000 MT of NPK-DAP capacity brought total NPK-DAP capacity to 495,000 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volumes for the quarter were 53,500 MT for NPK-DAP and 36,300 MT for SSP.
orders_capacity.quote: For NPK-DAP, it was 53,500 MT, for SSP 36,300 MT

orders_capacity.claim: The company operates an installed manufacturing capacity of 6.15 Lakh MTPA.
Healthy utilization was maintained across NPK/DAP and SSP plants, with certain units operating above 100% capacity.
orders_capacity.quote: Maintained healthy utilization across NPK/DAP and SSP plants, with certain units operating above 100% capacity, reflecting strong demand and efficient plant operations

orders_capacity.claim: The industry concluded Q4 FY26 with comfortable inventory levels of 177 lakh metric tonne.
orders_capacity.quote: The industry concluded Q4 FY26 with comfortable inventory levels of 177 lakh metric tonne indicating balanced supply-demand conditions and healthy channel inventory levels.

capital_allocation.claim: Krishana Phoschem completed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the share face value from ₹10 to ₹2.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: Depreciation rose to ₹13 crore and finance costs increased to ₹20 crore following the operationalization of new plant capacity.
capital_allocation.quote: Depreciation increased from around ₹8.7 crore to ₹13 crore, while finance costs increased from around ₹13 crore to ₹20 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: Disciplined capital allocation is identified as one of the company's five core strategic pillars.
capital_allocation.quote: Our strategic blueprint rests on five core pillars: backward integration, capacity expansion, product diversification, disciplined capital allocation and deep farmer connect.

risks_headwinds.claim: The phosphatic industry faced global supply-side disruptions, elevated raw material prices, and geopolitical uncertainties in Q1.
risks_headwinds.quote: The 1st Quarter witnessed a challenging operating environment for the phosphatic supplier industry, primarily driven by global supply-side disruptions, elevated raw material prices, and geopolitical uncertainties.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflict in West Asia disrupted critical shipping routes in the Strait of Hormuz, causing higher freight and procurement costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, particularly surrounding critical shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, introduced considerable uncertainty across global industry, global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Raw material availability was the primary operational challenge faced by the company in Q1.
risks_headwinds.quote: The primary challenge during the first quarter was the availability of raw materials.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sulphur prices increased from ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to nearly ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

risks_headwinds.claim: Input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the other hand, input cost volatility and global supply uncertainties remain key monitorable.

risks_headwinds.claim: The industry relies on imports for approximately 90% of key intermediates.
risks_headwinds.quote: Given the industry's reliance on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, these global movements had a direct impact on cost structure.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of over ₹500 crore across the remaining three quarters of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

management_commitments.claim: Green ammonia capacity under the procurement arrangement with SECI is expected to start in FY29.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management expressed confidence in sustaining momentum through the remainder of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We are confident of building on this momentum through the remainder of FY27, as we continue strengthening India's agri-future for our farmers, partners, & shareholders

management_commitments.claim: The company has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) for 70,000 MTPA under India's National Green Hydrogen Mission.
management_commitments.quote: Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

management_commitments.claim: The new capacity expansion has commenced production and is expected to stabilize over the next three to four months.
management_commitments.quote: As our Managing Director mentioned, our new expansion has already commenced production and is expected to stabilize over the next three to four months.

management_commitments.claim: Green ammonia is expected to be available only after approximately three years.
management_commitments.quote: As for green ammonia, it is expected to be available only after approximately three years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
